name: ImageWriteBase64
description: Writes Base64 images to the specified filename and destination.
syntax: ImageWriteBase64( any image, string destination, string format, [boolean inHTMLFormat] )

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: destination
params.description: The path for the destination file.

params.name: inHTMLFormat
params.description:
Specify whether Base64 output includes the headers used by the Base64 images in the HTML "img" tag ("data:image/{format};base64,...") :

- true
- false (default)
